description: subset_zeta mod.rs: original algorithm and independent finite correspondence
cost: k*n mask visits, k*n/2 modular additions, n normalizations; O(n log n) time and O(1) extra space. n<=2^20 bounds stage shifts and indices. No allocation inside transform.
forward: For n=2^k nonempty, modulus m>0, output y[S]=sum_{T subset S} x[T] mod m. Normalize then for each bit add the bit-cleared entry to bit-set entries. After j stages all submask choices in the processed j coordinates have been summed.
inverse: Typed behavior complement and ambiguous reverse reconstruction in model.md
limitations: Finite tests are not a proof; allocation refusal not injected; macros opaque and semantic AST absent
